product_metadata.title: Instant Pot Official Cooking Set, 3-piece, Assorted
features: OFFICIAL: Accessories specially designed to work with your Instant Pot
ENJOY DELICIOUS, NUTRITIOUS FOODS: Use this set to make quick, healthy meals & snacks with your Instant Pot
MULTI-USE: Use the pan for cooking, baking, storing, reheating & serving meals and snacks; use the egg tray for cooling and decorating eggs & as a trivet
SMART DESIGN: Pleated design of Steamer accommodates different cooker sizes; handles interlock and fit under lid while cooking; hook into feet for easy storage
DURABLE & SAFE: Made from stainless steel and BPA-free silicone; heat resistant to 450° F (232° C)
description: This essential Instant Pot Official 3-Piece Cooking Set is specially designed for use in Instant Pot pressure cookers. Cook & bake foods to perfection in the Round Pan, and use to store and reheat as the pan is freezer to Instant Pot compatible. Cook several foods at once using the stainless steel removable divider. The snap-fit silicone lid features a pressure-release tab for releasing steam. The Silicone Steamer Basket features secure-lock handles that neatly tuck under the lid of your Instant Pot while cooking, and provide safe, effortless removal of food after cooking. The handles also snap into the feet after use and cleaning for easy storage. Make 9 hard- or soft-boiled eggs using one Silicone Egg Rack and 18 when you stack two. Not only do the eggs come out just as desired, they are also easy to peel. Place rack in Instant Pot, then add eggs. You can also use the rack as a trivet to cool or decorate eggs. The pieces are made from stainless steel and BPA-free silicone, heat resistant up to 450° F (232° C). Handwashing is recommended. Compatible with 6-quart and 8-quart cookers; the Egg Rack is also compatible with 3-quart cookers.
